title: Fixed additive degree-zero section comparison
statement: For arbitrary f:X→S, L an O_X-module, k:W→S and t:T→W, with shared derived localizations, define an additive map from the derived test sections of Rp_W*(pr_X*L[0]) to Γ(X_T,L_T). Use the canonical lift a:X_T→X_W, the inverse mate c of pushforward composition to identify ordinary pullback of M=pr_X*L with L_T, and the base-change mate followed by the canonical single pullback map and that coefficient comparison. Conjugate the source by the canonical single pullback comparison of O_W and its ordinary structure map. Apply H^0, the canonical degree-zero direct-image isomorphism, evaluation at 1 and restriction from inverse-top to top. All data are explicit constructions; no arbitrary witness of mere existence is selected.

proof.text: Construct the fibre-product lift and the canonical inverse mate of pushforward composition. Compose the canonical base-change mate, single pullback comparison and coefficient isomorphism. The structure sheaf comparison is invertible by the canonical single pullback theorem. Take degree-zero homology and the direct-image H0 comparison, then evaluate at 1 and restrict to top. Additivity follows from additive homology, composition and module morphisms.

def picardDirectImageSectionMap {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) :
    picardDerivedModelSections
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) t →+
      Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤)
